title: The Power Of Praise
html:
In this week's MondayMotivator,

Praise and recognition evoke positive feelings and are essential for boosting morale.

Recognition fulfils a fundamental desire for love and validation, contributing to a sense of identity and purpose.

Appreciating others fosters connection and influence, as it acknowledges their importance and value.

When someone commented on your good job or praised you for some creative work you finished, how did you feel?

I bet you felt great! I know I do and see it in others when I praise them, too.

Many need to understand the power of praise.

People who feel limited in their identity often feel that way because of a lack of love or recognition, which, as I'm sure you're aware, is as basic a desire as being alive.

Recognition can satisfy your thirst for life and refresh that warm feeling of living in hope. Everyone wants to be recognised and to be somebody.

When you let others see that this is how you think about them, you will have a good audience, even if it is only one person. Others will instantly relate to you.

Those who have the most influence on other people are those who believe others are important.

You have the power to change others and make their lives better and more beautiful. A universal truth, though, is that before you can expect praise and recognition for yourself, you must first give it to others. Both children and adults alike.

This week think now is the time for me to appreciate and praise others. In doing so, I will recognise my own worth.
